title: Mushroom and Ovoli Gratins with Polish Sides
description: A delicious Chinese-inspired take on a classic gratin dish, featuring sautéed mushrooms, ovoli, and a side of polish flair.
instructions: In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Sauté the sliced mushrooms until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced ovoli and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 tbsp of soy sauce and 2 tbsp of pickled mustard seeds.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with grated cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown.
Serve hot with a side of polish flair.
